Established in 2005, Our Goal is...
"To relieve the suffering of animals of any species who are in need of care and attention, and in particular to provide or maintain refuge, secure homes, sanctuaries or other facilities for the reception and care of unwanted animals and the treatment of sick or ill-treated animals."
Donate securely at https://app.donorfy.com/form/SOK1GM5P83/Urgent-Appeal-1Aug24 or https://www.woodlandsanimalsanctuary.org.uk/donate/donate-online/
Our Objectives Include...
RESCUE - To rescue unwanted, ill-treated, abandoned or neglected animals.
REHABILITATE - The rehabilitation of these animals.
REHOME - To provide residential care, or wherever possible to foster out these animals into secure, permanent & loving environments.
EDUCATE - To educate and provide support and advice to the general public in the care of domestic & wild animals.
PROVIDE OPPORTUNITIES - To offer volunteering opportunities to everyone including people with mental health issues & special needs.
